title: Chat ID: SHA256 deterministic hash -> server-assigned ULID, participants -> contactId
description:
The I-D moved from deterministic SHA256 chat IDs to server-assigned ULIDs to support diverse identity systems. This is the largest change.

New model:
- Chat/set create with kind=direct: check if direct Chat with contactId already exists (find_direct_by_contact_id); if yes, return in 'updated'; if no, generate ULID, create chat
- Peer/deliver with unknown chatId: create new Chat with peer-supplied chatId, contactId = sender's userId (no recomputation — trust is from sender auth)
- Peer/deliver with known chatId: verify sender matches chat.contact_id; reject if mismatch

Chat struct change:
- Remove participants: Vec<String>
- Add contact_id: Option<String> (serde: contactId, skip_serializing_if None)

kith-store/src/chat.rs:
- Add find_direct_by_contact_id(contact_id) -> Option<Chat>
- Add create(chat_id, kind, contact_id, now) -> Chat (distinct from get_or_create)
- Load contact_id column in all row-mapping queries

kith-peer/src/lib.rs:
- Remove steps that recompute chatId and reject mismatches
- Replace with: get chat by chatId; if not found create with sender as contactId; if found verify sender == contact_id

kith-chat/src/: Chat/set handler uses new create path

kith-core/src/chat.rs: remove compute_chat_id, remove sha2 dep from Cargo.toml

Depends on: KITH-phdk, KITH-8ntb, KITH-j4v2
